single_next_experiment: Blinded observed-event and PPG-reference quality study before any model change
cases: All15 qualifying observed onsets; include the excluded22s onset for timing review
controls: Prespecified non-event windows matched by recording/current-SpO2 stratum and available history; do not choose from model scores
blinding: Outcome reviewers blinded to model predictions; PPG beat annotators additionally blinded to SpO2/event status
primary_measures: Pulse detection PPV/recall against independently annotated landmarks
limits: Does not establish arterial hypoxemia without reference data
No independent confirmation on repeatedly examined cohort
go_rule: Only if reference annotations establish a systematic causal detector/SQI defect, test one separately prespecified correction with grouping and all event coverage retained
stop_rule: If no systematic defect is demonstrated, preserve the bounded negative incremental-value result instead of further adaptive model search
